title: egg coddlers
text: egg coddlers. These are just adorable egg coddlers.  They could be used for condiment servers or pudding/custards or ? the bodies are a shiny ceramic.. the lids are a matte ceramic.  The lids do not fit perfectly on the bodies.. but they come with the silicone straps to keep the lids on while coddling.  The bodies are white, the lids are mix of matte pastel colors - but does look a little like Easter with the spring pastel colors.  They are the perfect size for 1 large size egg.  I just love these.  I did make the additional purchase of the bamboo serving tray.  I highly recommend that purchase.  Makes it so easy to serve and looks so simply elegant in the tray.  The coddle cups say they are dishwasher safe, but I am hand washing.  Arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition along with some other items I had ordered. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new seem useful.

product_metadata.title: AggCoddler - Porcelain & Silicone Egg Cookers - Easily Cook Eggs with Toppings & Mix-Ins - Microwave & Dishwasher Safe - Steam, Poach, Boil Eggs - Displays Well in Kitchen - Set of 4
features: ✔ COLLECT THEM ALL - Pack of 4 different colors makes for a perfect family set and an ideal display. Receive one each of blue, pink, yellow and green

✔ ​MAKE EGGS YOUR WAY - Just crack one or more eggs into the AggCoddler, and add any ingredient you desire - bacon, spices, veggies, spinach, salmon - get creative and make a delicious breakfast in one container!

✔ PORCELAIN & SILICONE MATERIAL - Simple Scandinavian design for a beautiful, simple device that looks right at home in any kitchen. Easy to clean, and doesn't have annoying metal crevices for food to get stuck in!
✔ ​MICROWAVE AND DISHWASHER SAFE - Specifically designed to be able to be microwaved (cup only) and put in the dishwasher (all pieces)! Perfect for a quick daily routine.

✔ ​BEATS THE COMPETITION - Most Egg Coddlers are made of metal and delicate glass, meaning they can't be microwaved, and need to be hand-washed. The AggCoddler is easier to use, less messy, and overall superior to our competition!
